snippet.title: Sky Strike Overdrive // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/5116760/Sky_Strike_Overdrive

Fast-paced 2D retro synthwave arcade shooter inspired by 80s classics. Pilot an advanced starfighter, dodge endless enemy waves, upgrade your arsenal, and chase the ultimate high score in a neon-drenched sci-fi universe.

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer:  MaverickBit
📚 Publisher: MaverickBit
📅 Release Date: Coming soon
🎯 Genre: Action, Casual, Indie
